IdleExit.fs.reason: idle-exit scheduler. Pure decision (shouldFire), the atomic FireLatch (incl. the 10k-thread fire-once test), resolveThreshold, isNonDefaultWorkspace, and runTick (fire / defer-on-busy / below-threshold / throwing-shutdown) are all unit-tested directly. The two uncovered lines are non-deterministic under unit tests: L149 is createTimer's onTick lambda body, which only runs when the live 30s System.Threading.Timer actually fires (its callee runTick is fully covered); L132 is runTick's tryFire-loser branch, reachable only when a concurrent tick wins the atomic CompareExchange first (exercised by the concurrency test but not hit on every instrumented run).
